nodes.rationale: Savings are modelled as messages x 3min x R$25/h converted at a fixed 5.5 BRL/USD reference rate; the assumptions are printed on the card so the number is not presented as a measured fact.

nodes.rationale: Evolution/Baileys remains supported but Meta Cloud API is the recommended path because Baileys carries WhatsApp-Web ban risk.

nodes.label: Autonomous Agent Governance Loop (100% + HITL)
nodes.rationale: Autonomy is documented as Thought -> Action -> Observation -> Evaluator -> Reflection bounded by max_trials; HITL thresholds are deliberately conservative because autonomy is presented as 100% + human-in-the-loop rather than unattended.

nodes.label: Lightweight Markdown Prompt Editor
nodes.rationale: The Monaco mount point is repurposed into a custom textarea + preview pane (initLightEditor) instead of loading Monaco, keeping the page dependency-free while preserving Markdown preview, token count and Ctrl+S save.

nodes.norm_label: prompt tag structure (6 tags / 12 tags advanced)

nodes.label: Prompt Validation (length + PT-BR language gate)
nodes.rationale: Submit is blocked for prompts under 20 or over 100k characters, and a prompt with no Portuguese/PT-BR marker requires an explicit confirmation.

nodes.label: Skills Import from URL (POST /api/skills/import-url, GET /api/skills)

nodes.label: Governance Blueprints - Deal Desk (5 Specialists)
